The image focuses on the upper tips of the fungal branches, which are cylindrical and divide into smaller, finger-like projections. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green and brown bokeh, suggesting a forest floor environment. A single dark, thin twig or pine needle intersects the right side of the fungal cluster.
